desc:
Get ready for the ultimate growth challenge! Every second, you grow bigger and every obstacle becomes a new test of your power.

🏆 How to Play:
Grow automatically every second!

🧱 Use your massive size to crush obstacles, unlock new zones, and dominate the server.
🔁 Rebirth to reset your size but unlock even faster growth with every cycle.
💪 Upgrade your growth multiplier to reach unbelievable sizes and claim the top spot!

Can you rise above everyone else and become the biggest in the universe? 🌌
👍 Like the game to support updates and new features!

Tags: big, huge, massive, growth, simulator, +1 height every second, grow every second, size simulator, height simulator
